name: Unidentified brown furry-faced species
description: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their long brown fur that covered almost all of their faces aside from their eyes, as well as sometimes a white horn extending from the top of their heads. In 4 ABY, at least one member of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren, and another worked for the crime lord Allic at a casino on the planet Qiaxx.
